notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354325/66d96f4269ce1dc95d25d8d61d83cf9e97d5c0ed.jpg[/img]
[h1]
The Moment has arrived, Crown of Hispania just launched its Kickstarter. [/h1]
We need helps from all of you, this is one of our unique chance to rise up in the Grand Strategy videogame market. 

The success of this campaign will allow for many fundings (Banks, Investors, Publisher, Subsidies) and more people to work on Crown of Hispania.
In the End of 2026, we will probably have a really decent game to release, at least in Early Access.

[u][b]Right now, the future of Crown of Hispania is in your hands. YOU can make it a success.[/b][/u]

notes.title: Kickstarter Launch Date Announcement : 22/02/2025
notes.content:
[h1][b]Kickstarter Launch Date Announcement ❤️[/b][/h1]
[h2]Hello Crown of Hispania Supporters ![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354325/fb6f549bc82e96566197bcd7ecb587ed7c6867fa.png[/img]

We’re thrilled to announce that the Kickstarter campaign for Crown of Hispania will officially launch on 22nd February 2025! 🎯

This is your chance to support the development of a grand strategy game like no other, set in the turbulent 11th-century Iberian Peninsula. Build kingdoms, forge alliances, and rewrite history with your choices! 

[h2]What’s in it for you?[/h2]
Get the Game at Launch
Access to Closed Beta in 2025 
Exclusive Kickstarter rewards 🏅
Behind-the-scenes development updates 📜
The opportunity to shape the game’s future with your feedback!

[h2]Mark your calendars 📅, spread the word 📢, and prepare to embark on an unforgettable journey.
Let’s make Crown of Hispania a reality—together! 💛[/h2]

👉 Stay tuned for more details in the coming weeks!

It would be a huge help if you could follow our Kickstarter page now—you’ll get notified as soon as we launch! 🚀 Plus, early backers will have access to exclusive reduced prices, so don’t miss out! 🙌

This campaign will also feature a small prototype demo—available if we reach 200 backers! Help us hit this milestone and be among the first to experience a glimpse of Crown of Hispania!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/regalisstudio/crown-of-hispania]Join and Follow Crown of Hispania Kickstarter in Prelaunch[/url]
